executive_summary.text: The business achieved a total revenue of ₹34.0 Cr with a ROAS of 4.57x across all channels. Paid Search remains the primary driver, contributing 55.3% of total revenue from 44.8% of the total spend.

key_findings.text: Paid Search is the most efficient revenue driver with a ROAS of 5.65x, significantly outperforming the paid-media average ROAS of 4.57x.
The funnel experiences its most significant drop at the click-to-lead stage, where only 5.6% of clicks convert into leads.
Early-Career Professionals represent the most valuable customer segment, delivering a ROAS of 5.57x and accounting for 63.4% of total revenue.

performance_concerns.text: Video channels show the weakest performance among paid media with a ROAS of 2.26x, well below the overall average of 4.57x.
Meta - Digital Marketing Prospecting, which accounts for 8.8% of total spend, is underperforming with a ROAS of 1.55x.

hypotheses.text: The low click-to-lead rate of 5.6% may be caused by misalignment between ad messaging and landing page content.
hypotheses.validation_step: Review landing page bounce rates and form completion rates by campaign to identify if specific pages are underperforming.

hypotheses.text: The high CPL in the Professional Network channel (₹1,363) might be due to overly restrictive targeting criteria.
hypotheses.validation_step: Compare audience reach and engagement metrics for the Professional Network against other channels to see if the audience is too narrow.

investigation_areas.text: Investigate the root cause of the high-severity incident I04 in the East region, which resulted in an estimated ₹11.8 L loss.
Analyze the impact of the Google Ads platform incident I09, which caused a 99.1% drop in clicks over two days.

recommendations.text: Implement stricter monitoring for Google Search campaigns to prevent future losses similar to the ₹1.6 L impact from incident I09.
Shift budget from Meta - Digital Marketing Prospecting (ROAS 1.55x) to Affiliate (ROAS 6.67x) to improve overall efficiency, starting with a small test shift.
Reallocate budget from Video campaigns (ROAS 2.26x) to Paid Search (ROAS 5.65x), noting that Video's upper-funnel contribution may be undervalued in current ROAS metrics.

limitations.text: ROAS calculations are based on revenue recorded per campaign, which may undervalue upper-funnel channels like Video that contribute to demand generation.
CAC is calculated as Spend / Conversions due to the absence of a unique customer identifier in the dataset.
